body:
I being very experienced with opiate painkillers have found this one to be my very favorite.  I am readilly prescribed this for migraine headaches so I have very easy access.  The high is very good, it is much like that of hydrocodone.  It takes effect within 1-3 minutes,
the first time I took it, it knocked me on my ass.  It provides a very euphoric experience for me and makes me extremely social, I talk like crazy and act really wild, and super hungry which considering it is an opiate is very unusual.  I haven't used in about 3 months but I am sure I was addicted, and I got a very high tolerance for it.  The only bad thing is it only last for about 4 hours and it will keep me awake.  The worst part is I can't pee for like 6 hours.  However I love stadol.  I have tried oxy, hydrocod, codiene, morphine, nalbutaine, and darvocets.  I usually stick with the hydrocodone because stadol is a bit pricey and almost impossible to find with out a prescription.
Happy Euphoria
-The Spartan King
